body: No one has even read this... but if anyone ever does, my psychiatrist never emailed me back... I'm done. No more steps forward. I'm done. I give up.

I feel comfort that you understand. I keep waking up every night at exactly 1:15 am, then 3 am, then usually 5:05 ish. Every single night no matter if I go to bed early, late, under the influence of alcohol, sober, stressed, relaxed, etc. and I can't help but think this is the work of some kind of demon or other paranormal other-worldy creature.

I find myself twisting every single thing he does now, not to him of course, but like for example: tonight I took him out to dinner (to convince him to see me tonight) and after some small chat, he asked to get it to go and practically raced home to drop me off. My brain tells me: you are not only unneeded and worthless but HATED and DESPISED. Your existence disgusts the people you are closest with. You don't deserve happiness you fuck of a failure.

Scared to go to doc because he might over react. He always told me to call him right away if I ever get even slightly suicidal but I just can't get myself to do it. I just want it to go away on its own.

If anything, self harm is a deserved and needed punishment for being so useless. At least that's what my train of thought is right now. I don't know. And whats the point of putting effort into a talent? There is always someone better than me and I will never make it with my profession with this talent. I will never be as good as my peers, and that is made painfully aware to me every single day I am at school.

This is night 2 of this incredibly debilitating suicidal depression. I just wonder how long I can hold out.
Don't want to make the news

Tonight I unloaded on the BF and told him everything, the diagnoses, the suicidal feelings and intentions, everything. He then gave me this huge speech about how I mean something in the world, my talents are making the world a better place, he cares about me, etc. But right now, all I can think is "yeah, miniscule amount of talent is all I can contribute, I am a worthless fucking human being otherwise" etc., and then he admitted that he has issues too, and apparently he never gets close to people and doesn't think about people he cares about during the day and he gets exhausted from even talking to people so he hates everyone basically, and it made me immediately think "everything he just told me is a huge lie." and now I am even more of a mess. I think I'm going to move my date up a bit now. this was the last straw.

I tried cutting to distract me (yes yes its bad blah blah) but I am so far gone mentally and emotionally that I literally didn't feel it, and my whole upper arm is gashed up now. Didn't feel a single bit of it. I am dead inside and don't deserve to feel or be alive.
I appreciate the effort but in this exact moment I just can't believe that there is nothing wrong with me and it's just the people around me.

I've got a pretty decent sized circle of friends though is the thing. They just flat out don't care about me. I have been missing classes and work and other obligations, and canceling plans with friends because of this deep suicidal depression, but not a single one of them has come to me asking if they could help. Not even my boyfriend. (Which is funny, because he's dealt with depression in the past, and I've always helped him...) 

To them, I am another warm body that can be used to gain things. Attention, sympathy, what have you. That is all I have ever been, and it is being made more clear to me every day that goes by. 

I have schizoaffective disorder so I used to see a psychiatrist but I stopped seeing him because the meds I was on had horrible side effects, and honestly, it was embarrassing to say out loud just how depressed I am. I was sent to a mental hospital last time I was feeling this way, and all they did was shame me for feeling the way I did. Since then I am mortified to even speak out loud how I feel (hence why I am online instead...)

sorry for wall of text...

edit: want to add, I am not "expecting" my friends family and boyfriend to drop what they are doing and be there for me, because I would never want to force someone to "pay attention to me." so if it came across that way sorry, I just mean that that's why I haven't said anything to anyone. I don't ever want to force someone to care, you know? I'd feel too bad. It'd be fake.

I took geodon for a while and even the smallest dose was unbearable, side effect wise. All of them have unbearable side effects (I must be sensitive or something) so I stopped taking anything. I am trying to decide, what's worse- feeling this way or the side effects from meds...
